notes: Official Colors of California product page. Establishes the exact public model name: 'Glossy rainboot'.
The site's URL grammar is /en-ot/shoponline/<slug>.<article>?color=<CODE>, confirmed across several articles, so the colour is a query parameter rather than part of the article number.

PRODUCT TYPE: this is a rubber RAIN BOOT, not a sneaker. The RB prefix in the article number is consistent across the brand's rainboot line (rbnew03 = 'chelsie-rainboot', rbnew012 = 'chelsea-rainboot', rb0041 = 'rainboot-with-neoprene-collar'). Every product PINK MALL has onboarded through this pipeline so far has been a sneaker.
COLOUR CODE RESOLVED BY THE SOURCE, NOT BY ME: fetching the bare product URL redirected to ?color=FUX, so the site itself selected the fuxia colourway as this article's default. FUX is the pink one.

OBSERVED CDN HOST: hub2.artcrafts.it. Taken from the official page's own image declarations in the previous run's rejection log, never guessed. Artcrafts is the Italian distributor that operates this brand's e-commerce, which is why the media does not sit on colorsofcalifornia.it.
Asset paths are self-evidencing twice over: /_public/resized/1200x1200/HC/F24/FUX/HC.F24.RBGLOW01-FUX-<n>.jpg carries both the article code and the colour code.

ALIASES ARE COLOUR-SCOPED ON PURPOSE. The asset naming inserts the season code into the middle of the article number (HC.F24.RBGLOW01), so the bare article number does not appear in its own images. A colour-agnostic alias would recover them but would also admit the sibling MUD colourway; scoping to RBGLOW01-FUX keeps the wrong colourway out of the candidate pool entirely instead of relying on selection to prefer the right one.
Corroborates that a PINK colourway of this exact article exists ('HC RBGLOW01 Pink rosa'), and that the size scale runs EU 36-41.
Marketplace listing: used as identity corroboration ONLY. It is excluded as a media source under the source hierarchy and contributes no image.

PASS 3. Pass 2 allow-listed the real CDN and still acquired nothing: the identity gate rejected every image because HC.RBGLOW01 is not a substring of HC.F24.RBGLOW01-FUX-1.jpg — the season code sits inside the article number.
The alias machinery already existed but was never wired into sku_signal. It is now, and only EVIDENCED aliases are accepted, so the gate is not loosened.
Aliases here are colour-scoped, which also solves the problem 398855 had to solve with a reconnaissance sweep: the sibling MUD colourway cannot enter the candidate pool at all.
The pink colour code FUX was resolved by the site itself — the bare product URL redirects to ?color=FUX.
PRODUCT TYPE: rubber rain boot. SHOES > Boots approved as a new subcategory.
